name: DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
notes: DeepSeek-V2 paper (arXiv 2405.04434). Introduces Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). Table 1: KV cache per token in elements: MHA 2*n_h*d_h*l, GQA 2*n_g*d_h*l, MQA 2*d_h*l, MLA (d_c+d_rh)*l. With d_c=4*d_h and d_rh=d_h/2, MLA = 4.5*d_h*l, equal to GQA with only 2.25 groups. 93.3% KV cache reduction vs dense DeepSeek 67B, 5.76x max generation throughput. Absorption: W_UK into W_Q, W_UV into W_O.
